name: Rod of Metamagic, Echoinggreater
body:
Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Echoing
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 188
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 14,000 gp (lesser), 54,000 gp (normal), 121,500 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that can be cast an additional time that day as if using the Echoing Spell feat (Ultimate Magic).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Echoing Spell; Cost 7,000 gp (lesser), 27,000 gp (normal), 60,750 gp (greater)
